title: TwinRouterBench: Fast Static and Live Dynamic Evaluation for Realistic Agentic LLM Routing
abstract: arXiv:2605.18859v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: LLM routing matters most in long-horizon applications such as coding agents, deep research systems, and computer-use agents, where a single user request triggers many model calls. Routing each call to the cheapest sufficient model can cut costs without sacrificing quality, yet existing router benchmarks evaluate routers only on one-shot prompts. They never expose the router-visible prefix at an intermediate agent step, never test whether a cheaper replacement preserves downstream task success, and often rely on online LLM judges at evaluation time. We introduce TwinRouterBench, a step-level routing benchmark with two tracks. The static track provides 970 router-visible prefixes from 520 instances across SWE-bench, BFCL, mtRAG, QMSum, and PinchBench, each paired with an execution-verified target tier estimated under a released downgrade-and-cascade protocol; scoring is deterministic arithmetic over tier labels, trajectory member

translated_title: TwinRouterBench：面向真实智能体化LLM路由的快速静态与实时动态评估
translated_abstract: LLM路由在代码智能体、深度研究系统和计算机使用智能体等长周期应用中最为关键，因为在这类应用中，单个用户请求会触发多次模型调用。将每次调用路由到满足需求的最低成本模型可以在不牺牲质量的情况下降低成本，然而现有的路由器基准仅在单轮（one-shot）提示上评估路由器。它们从不在智能体执行的中间步骤向路由器暴露可见前缀，从不测试更便宜的替代模型是否能保持下游任务的成功，并且通常在评估时依赖在线LLM裁判。我们提出了TwinRouterBench，一个包含两条轨道的步骤级路由基准。静态轨道提供来自SWE-bench、BFCL、mtRAG、QMSum和PinchBench共520个实例的970个路由器可见前缀，每个前缀都配有一个在已发布的降级与级联协议下估计的、经执行验证的目标层级；评分是对层级标签、轨迹成员……进行的确定性算术运算。
tldr: TwinRouterBench是一个步骤级LLM路由评估基准，通过包含970个经执行验证前缀的静态轨道和实时动态轨道，首次在智能体执行的真实中间步骤上评估路由决策，弥补了现有基准仅测试单轮提示的不足。
en_tdlr: TwinRouterBench is a step-level LLM routing benchmark featuring a static track with 970 execution-verified router-visible prefixes and a live dynamic track, which for the first time evaluates routing at realistic intermediate agent steps, addressing the gap left by existing benchmarks that only test one-shot prompts.
